senses.gloss: to precede; to do early, be early, first.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 69:32">Targ. Ps. LXIX, 32</cite> <he>דקַדִּימוּ קרנוי וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>דקָדִ׳</he>) whose horns grew prior to its hoofs.

<cite ref="Tamid 27b:39">Tam. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>וקַדֵּים וכ׳</he>, v. <he>הֲשַׁךְ</he> I; a. e.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 88:14">Targ. Ps. LXXXVIII, 14</cite>.

senses.gloss: to get the start of; to prevent.
units: Targ. Ps. XVII, 13; a. e.—3) to be earlier than, be quick in doing. Ib. CXIX, 147, sq.; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 119a:9">Sabb. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>אי רגיליתו לאַקְדּוּמֵי … אַקְדִּימוּ</he> if you are accustomed to take an early meal, make it later (on the Sabbath), and if you are used to dine late, dine earlier. Ib. 151ᵇ when a poor man comes, <he>אַקְדִּים … דליקַדְּמוּ וכ׳</he> be quick in giving him bread, in order that people may be ready to do so to thy children.

senses.gloss: to give preference to. Y. Snh. I, 18ᶜ bot. אַקִדְּמוּן ליה … בעיבור they preferred a certain old man to him at the session for intercalation; Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ top; a. e.
